correctness.rationale: For each angular gap 0<delta_i<pi, the adjacent inequalities are equivalent to d_i=alpha_i Ja_i+beta_i Ja_{i+1} with nonnegative uniquely recovered coefficients. Summing d_i=0 identifies the translation quotient with a nonnegative kernel of a rank-two matrix with two copies of each tangent t_i. For any pair (i,j), one of the two circular arcs has its intervening tangents of constant appropriate dot-product sign with a_i, proving all n(n-1) support comparisons from adjacent ones, including antipodal endpoint separation. Every tangent has a strictly positive coefficient in a zero-sum combination because the normals have no gap >=pi; splitting that coefficient into its two copies supplies a relative-interior witness with precisely one prescribed zero coordinate, proving each of the 2n half-spaces is a genuine facet. Positive minimal kernel supports in R^2 are exactly antipodal pairs and strict-origin triangles, and identical copies cannot coexist minimally. Four and eight copy choices count rays. For regular n directions count central gap triples with maximal cyclic gap <n/2; inclusion-exclusion yields n(n^2-1)/24 triples odd or n(n-2)(n-4)/24 even; adding n/2 antipodal pairs gives the displayed ray formulas. Explicit finite independent enumeration confirms n=3..18 but is not used as proof for arbitrary n.
